QUANTUM VULNERABLE   Shor's algorithm breaks these outright

  RSA  (no call sites, 3 algorithm names)
    Shor's algorithm factors the modulus in polynomial time.
    migrate to: ML-KEM-768 for key establishment, ML-DSA-65 for signatures
      tokens.py:3   ALGORITHMS = {"RS256": "rsa", "ES256K": "secp256k1", "HS512": "hmac"}
      tokens.py:7   return jwt.encode(payload, key, algorithm="PS256")
      tokens.py:15   return {"alg": "RSA-OAEP", "enc": "A128CBC-HS256"}

  ECDSA  (no call sites, 2 algorithm names)
    Shor's algorithm solves the discrete log on the curve.
    migrate to: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204), or SLH-DSA if you need hash-based
      tokens.py:3   ALGORITHMS = {"RS256": "rsa", "ES256K": "secp256k1", "HS512": "hmac"}
      tokens.py:11   return jwt.decode(token, key, algorithms=["ES384", "EdDSA"])

  EdDSA  (no call sites, 1 algorithm name)
    Edwards-curve discrete log falls to Shor's algorithm. The curve, Ed25519 or Ed448, was not visible to the scanner.
    migrate to: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204), or ML-DSA-87 if the curve is Ed448
      tokens.py:11   return jwt.decode(token, key, algorithms=["ES384", "EdDSA"])


REVIEW               reduced margin under Grover, usually acceptable

  SHA-256  (no call sites, 3 algorithm names)
    Grover gives a quadratic speedup only. Still acceptable.
    migrate to: no action needed

      tokens.py:15   return {"alg": "RSA-OAEP", "enc": "A128CBC-HS256"}

  AES  (no call sites, 1 algorithm name)
    Grover halves effective key length. AES-256 stays at 128-bit margin.
    migrate to: AES-256 if currently AES-128
